title: Vuetify 1.5 documentation website
lede: The archived home page of Vuetify 1.5, a Material Design component framework for Vue: a blue hero with three raised white cards.
summary: A blue hero with a light-weight title, outlined buttons, and three white cards lifted by large soft shadows.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: white cards on a blue field with soft shadows, all-capital buttons, and Roboto follow the style, but the hero is a vertical blue gradient and the card shadows are larger than Material’s resting elevations.

notice: This is the archived documentation for version 1.5. The current Vuetify site uses Material 3.
observed: A yellow strip at the top says that Vuetify 1 has reached end of life. Below it is a white bar with the Vuetify logo.
The hero is blue, lighter toward the bottom. A large round white logo sits beside the title “Material Design Component Framework” in light Roboto.
A white GET STARTED button with blue all-capital text stands beside two outlined buttons, GITHUB and GET HELP.
Three white cards with square corners and large soft shadows show an illustration, a wireframe, and a dark terminal window, each above a bold title and centered text.
interpretation: The page measures a shadow on 45 % of its boxes, but with a median blur of 22 px and offset of 12 px, and a gradient share of 0.62 from the hero. It fails three fingerprint metrics for those reasons.
borrow: Put three raised white cards across the seam between a colored hero and the page below, so that the shadows carry the change of level.

images.alt: Vuetify 1.5 home page: a yellow end-of-life notice, a blue hero with a round white logo and the title Material Design Component Framework, a white GET STARTED button beside two outlined buttons, and three white cards with soft shadows.
images.caption: First viewport of [v15.vuetifyjs.com](https://v15.vuetifyjs.com/en/).
